lines.369680624416010242: I like the sound of that.
lines.369680624416010243: Who knows, maybe there’s gonna be another assignment. I can use a dependable guy like you.
lines.369680624420204544: I don’t know if I have it in me.
lines.369680624420204545: Maybe you’ll feel different about it in the morning.
lines.369680624420204546: You've got a bright future ahead of you, Walker.
lines.369680624420204548: Walker? You don't sound so good.
lines.369680624420204549: I'm fine, mr Jackman. A bit banged up is all.
lines.369680624428593152: Sounds like an occupational hazard. You should patch yourself up, I can't have you croaking on me out there.
lines.369680624428593153: You're my number one investment, Walker. I need you in one piece or you're no good to me.
lines.369680624428593154: I'll try and be more careful.
lines.369680624478924801: I thought I heard crying. Are you all right?
lines.369680624478924802: I don’t think I should be talking to you. You shouldn’t be here. I shouldn’t be here either. This is all wrong.
lines.369680624483119104: You’re right to be careful, it’s dangerous out here. Keep your door locked. I’m sorry to have disturbed you.
lines.369680624483119105: You’re not safe either. I’ve seen what’s out there. I’ve seen the little man. He will tear you to pieces.
lines.369680624487313408: Get out while you still can.
lines.369680624487313409: I can’t leave. I have a job to do, I’m looking for his man…
lines.369680624487313410: They’ll eat you alive. You won’t stand a chance.
lines.369680624487313412: I’m sorry. I’m sorry you’re out there, doing all the things that you do. I’m sorry that I’m stuck in this room.
lines.369680624487313413: I wish it was all different, but it isn’t.
lines.369680624487313414: Just try to stay safe and everything will be all right.
lines.369680624491507712: Wait. I have something for you.
lines.369680624491507713: There’s a supply locker in the motel shop.  It’s no use to me but maybe it will help you. The code is 6671.
lines.369680624495702016: He bit me in the neck.
lines.369680624495702018: The man. The bad little man. He did other things too.
lines.369680624504090624: He said he is going to eat me.
lines.369680624504090625: He’s coming for you. Just like he came for that girl in the water.
lines.369680624504090626: No one is getting out of here.
lines.369680624508284928: What do you mean no one is getting out?
lines.369680624508284929: I don't remember how I got here. Nothing makes any sense.
lines.369680624508284930: There's a girl in the water and the little man won't leave her alone.
lines.369680624508284931: He never lets anyone go. Not me, not you, not anyone.
lines.369680624512479232: Who is the little man? What did he do?
lines.369680624512479233: I wish I could just wake up.
lines.369680624512479234: Why can't I just wake up?
lines.369680624520867840: Do you think they'll ever find her?
